title: Your Own Type
story: A struct groups fields. A method is a function attached to a type.
goal: Give Rect an Area() method and a Perimeter() method.
hints: A method looks like a function with the receiver in parentheses before the name: func (r Rect) Area() float64.
socratic: What does the receiver (r Rect) give you inside the method?
Why are the fields float64 and not int?
Which one would change the struct: a value receiver or a pointer receiver?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Your Own Type”?
